pred-sql: WITH ranked_stations AS ( SELECT rental_methods, capacity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rental_methods ORDER BY capacity) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rental_methods) AS cnt FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_stations WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL ), median_by_method AS ( SELECT rental_methods, AVG(CAST(capacity AS REAL)) AS median_capacity FROM ranked_stations WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) GROUP BY rental_methods ) SELECT s.name FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_stations s JOIN median_by_method m ON s.rental_methods <=> m.rental_methods WHERE s.capacity > m.median_capacity AND s.station_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_trips WHERE start_station_id IS NOT NULL );

SELECT输出列不同：Gold SQL输出 rental_methods、name、capacity、station_id、latitude、longitude 共6列；Pred SQL仅输出 name 一列，缺少其他字段。2. 中位数计算方法不同：Gold SQL使用精确的插值中位数（加权平均），能正确处理任意数量的记录；Pred SQL使用取中间两个值的平均值（AVG），但在记录数为偶数时，其筛选条件 `rn IN ((cnt+1)/2, (cnt+2)/2)` 会产生非整数导致只取到一个中间值（例如 cnt=4 时 IN (2.5,3) 实际只匹配 rn=3），造成中位数计算错误，进而影响 `capacity > median` 的过滤结果。3. pred-sql: WITH project_gene_baseline AS ( SELECT project_short_name, Gene, AVG(Expr) AS avg_expr FROM qotm_paad_kirp_random_sample_1002 WHERE project_short_name IN ('TCGA-PAAD', 'TCGA-KIRP', 'PAAD', 'KIRP') AND Expr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_short_name, Gene ), high_expr_with_protein AS ( SELECT q.project_short_name, q.ID, q.Gene, q.Expr, b.avg_expr, q.Expr / b.avg_expr AS expr_vs_avg, p.protein_expression FROM qotm_paad_kirp_random_sample_1002 q JOIN project_gene_baseline b ON q.project_short_name = b.project_short_name AND q.Gene = b.Gene JOIN tcga_hg38_data_v0_protein_expression p ON q.project_short_name = p.project_short_name AND q.ID = p.sample_barcode AND q.Gene = p.gene_name WHERE q.project_short_name IN ('TCGA-PAAD', 'TCGA-KIRP', 'PAAD', 'KIRP') AND q.Expr IS NOT NULL AND b.avg_expr IS NOT NULL AND b.avg_expr > 0 AND q.Expr > 1.5 * b.avg_expr AND p.protein_expression IS NOT NULL ) SELECT project_short_name, Gene, COUNT(*) AS supporting_samples, ROUND(AVG(Expr), 4) AS avg_high_expr, ROUND(AVG(avg_expr), 4) AS project_gene_baseline_expr, ROUND(AVG(expr_vs_avg), 4) AS avg_fold_vs_baseline, ROUND(AVG(protein_expression), 4) AS avg_protein_expression FROM high_expr_with_protein GROUP BY project_short_name, Gene ORDER BY project_short_name, avg_fold_vs_baseline DESC, supporting_samples DESC;

pred-sql: WITH yearly_avg AS ( SELECT Modality AS Category, YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(AcquisitionDate)) AS Year, AVG(SliceThickness) AS avg_thickness FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.tcga_versioned_radiology_images_tcia_2018_06 GROUP BY Modality, YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(AcquisitionDate)) ), above_avg AS ( SELECT t.Modality AS Category, t.PatientID AS Entity, YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(t.AcquisitionDate)) AS Year, t.SliceThickness AS Measure, CASE WHEN t.SliceThickness > ya.avg_thickness THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.tcga_versioned_radiology_images_tcia_2018_06 t JOIN yearly_avg ya ON t.Modality = ya.Category AND YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(t.AcquisitionDate)) = ya.Year ), consecutive AS ( SELECT Category, Entity, Year, above, LAG(above) OVER (PARTITION BY Category, Entity ORDER BY Year) AS prev_above FROM above_avg ) SELECT DISTINCT Category, Entity FROM consecutive WHERE above = 1 AND prev_above = 1;
Effective diff desc: gold_sql使用EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AcquisitionDate)提取年份，而pred_sql使用YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(AcquisitionDate))，假设AcquisitionDate是Unix时间戳则语义等价，但如果是日期类型则FROM_UNIXTIME会导致错误，两种函数语义不等价且可能导致不同结果

pred-sql:
WITH study_data AS (
  SELECT 
    m.TYPE, 
    m.variant_id, 
    m.AF
  FROM mnpr01_201703 AS m
  JOIN cs3k_project_info AS c ON m.RUN = c.Run
  WHERE 
    c.Organism = 'Cannabis'
    AND c.ReleaseDate >= '2017-03-01' 
    AND c.ReleaseDate <= '2017-03-31'
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
  TYPE AS Category, 
  variant_id AS Entity
FROM (
  SELECT 
    TYPE, 
    variant_id, 
    AF, 
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TYPE ORDER BY AF DESC) AS pct_rank
  FROM study_data
) AS ranked
WHERE pct_rank < 0.05

pred-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT t.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS topic, SUM(t.DAILY_TOTAL_FLOW) AS amt FROM `IOC_NaturalGas`.ng_gas_realtime_user_data t WHERE t.DATA_DATE >= '2025-07-06' AND t.DATA_DATE < '2025-07-08' AND t.INDUSTRY_TYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.INDUSTRY_TYPE ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, CAST(amt AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;

        DATE(t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME) AS arrival_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_cnt

            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING

WITH daily_cnt AS (
    SELECT DATE(b.begin_shift_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS day_record_cnt
    FROM balance_information b
    WHERE b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY DATE(b.begin_shift_time)

SELECT 
    d.stat_date,
    d.day_record_cnt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b2
        WHERE b2.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b2.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS prior_7d_avg_record_cnt,
    d.day_record_cnt - (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b3
        WHERE b3.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b3.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg

    mc.NODE_ALIAS AS node_alias,

question: 我想看每类装置类型下，设计能力最高的装置名称分别是谁。
Gold-sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT t.UNIT_TYPE_ID AS topic, t.UNIT_NAME AS entity_name, t.CAPACITY AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.UNIT_TYPE_ID ORDER BY t.CAPACITY DESC, t.UNIT_NAME) AS rn FROM Refinery.pm_unit_t t WHERE t.UNIT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL AND t.UNIT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND t.CAPACITY IS NOT NULL ) SELECT topic, entity_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY qty DESC;
pred-sql: SELECT t1.UNIT_NAME, t1.UNIT_TYPE_ID, t1.CAPACITY FROM pm_unit_t t1 JOIN (SELECT UNIT_TYPE_ID, MAX(CAPACITY) as max_capacity FROM pm_unit_t GROUP BY UNIT_TYPE_ID) t2 ON t1.UNIT_TYPE_ID = t2.UNIT_TYPE_ID AND t1.CAPACITY = t2.max_capacity
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用子查询取最大容量后连接，当存在并列最高设计能力时会返回多条记录；gold_sql通过ROW_NUMBER按容量降序和名称排序取rn=1，每个类型仅返回一条记录

pred-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT u.UNIT_TYPE_ID AS topic, u.UNIT_NAME AS entity_name, MAX(u.CAPACITY) AS amt FROM PM_UNIT_T u WHERE u.UNIT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL AND u.UNIT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND u.CAPACITY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.UNIT_TYPE_ID, u.UNIT_NAME ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY amt DESC, entity_name ) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity_name, amt FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY amt DESC;
Effective diff desc: pred_sql先按UNIT_TYPE_ID和UNIT_NAME分组取MAX(CAPACITY)，导致每个装置类型-装置名称组合只有一条记录，再排序取第一，无法正确处理同一装置类型下不同装置名称的设计能力比较；gold_sql直接对每个装置类型的所有装置按CAPACITY排序取第一，逻辑不等价

pred-sql: WITH a AS ( SELECT p.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS qty_a FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 13:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 15:00:00' GROUP BY p.payment_type ), b AS ( SELECT p.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS qty_b FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 17:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 19:00:00' GROUP BY p.payment_type ) SELECT COALESCE(a.payment_type, b.payment_type) AS payment_type, IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS qty_a, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) AS qty_b, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) - IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS diff FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.payment_type = b.payment_type UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.payment_type, b.payment_type) AS payment_type, IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS qty_a, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) AS qty_b, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) - IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS diff FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.payment_type = b.payment_type ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: 差值计算方向相反：gold_sql计算13-15点减17-19点的订单量变化(delta_cnt)，而pred_sql计算17-19点减13-15点(diff)，导致ORDER BY结果排序相反，升温/走弱判断颠倒

question: 在 2018 年 5 月 23 日下午 3 点到 5 点这个时间窗内，各支付方式分别贡献了多少回款，占总回款的比重是多少？
Gold-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT op.payment_type AS topic, SUM(op.payment_value) AS amt FROM BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE.OLIST_ORDER_PAYMENTS op JOIN BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE.OLIST_ORDERS o ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATETIME) >= '2018-05-23 15:00:00' AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATETIME) < '2018-05-23 17:00:00' GROUP BY op.payment_type ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;
pred-sql: WITH payment_agg AS ( SELECT op.payment_type, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM olist_orders oo JOIN olist_order_payments op ON oo.order_id = op.order_id WHERE CAST(oo.order_approved_at AS DATETIME) >= '2018-05-23 15:00:00' AND CAST(oo.order_approved_at AS DATETIME) < '2018-05-23 17:00:00' GROUP BY op.payment_type ), total_payment AS ( SELECT SUM(total_payment) AS grand_total FROM payment_agg ) SELECT pa.payment_type, pa.total_payment, pa.total_payment / NULLIF((SELECT grand_total FROM total_payment), 0) AS payment_share FROM payment_agg pa ORDER BY pa.total_payment DESC
Effective diff desc: 时间过滤条件不同：Gold使用order_purchase_timestamp，Pred使用order_approved_at，导致过滤出的订单不同；排序不同：Gold按占比降序，Pred按金额降序。

pred-sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders,  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS delivered_ratio  FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2  ORDER BY delivered_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)计算订单数而gold_sql使用COUNT(*)，且pred_sql额外关联了olist_sellers表并返回了不同的列集合（缺少total_cnt，多了total_orders和delivered_orders），导致计算逻辑和返回结果不一致

question: 我想比较 2019 年 3 月 1 日到 10 日和 3 月 20 日到 31 日这两个时间段里，不同促销大类的销售记录数差异，看看哪些活动类型在前一段时间比后一段时间更热，先给我前 3 个。
Gold-sql: SELECT p.promo_category, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-01' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-03-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-20' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, ( SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-01' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-03-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-20' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS delta_cnt FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_category ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql: WITH sales_period_1 AS (SELECT s.promo_id, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 10 GROUP BY s.promo_id), sales_period_2 AS (SELECT s.promo_id, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 20 AND 31 GROUP BY s.promo_id), promo_sales_diff AS (SELECT p.promo_category, IFNULL(sp1.sales_count, 0) - IFNULL(sp2.sales_count, 0) AS difference FROM promotions p LEFT JOIN sales_period_1 sp1 ON p.promo_id = sp1.promo_id LEFT JOIN sales_period_2 sp2 ON p.promo_id = sp2.promo_id) SELECT promo_category, difference FROM promo_sales_diff WHERE difference > 0 ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL多了WHERE difference > 0过滤条件，只返回差值大于0的promo_category，而Gold SQL返回所有类别；Pred SQL仅选择两列(promo_category, difference)，Gold SQL选择四列(promo_category, curr_cnt, prev_cnt, delta_cnt)；Pred SQL使用LEFT JOIN保留所有promo，Gold SQL使用JOIN仅保留有匹配的promo，结合过滤后导致结果集不同。

pred-sql: SELECT p.promo_category, SUM(CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-01' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-20' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, (SUM(CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-01' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-20' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS delta_cnt FROM sales s JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE p.promo_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.promo_category ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: pred_sql缺少CAST(s.time_id AS DATE)类型转换且日期边界条件错误（使用<=代替<导致包含3月11日和4月1日），并额外添加了WHERE p.promo_category IS NOT NULL过滤条件

question: 在 2019 年 3 月上旬这个指定周期里，各类促销分别吃掉了多少销售额份额？我想看收入结构是怎么分布的。
Gold-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT p.promo_category AS topic, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amt FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-01' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-03-11' GROUP BY p.promo_category ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;
pred-sql: WITH sales_filtered AS (SELECT s.promo_id, s.amount_sold FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month <= 10), agg_sales AS (SELECT p.promo_category, SUM(sf.amount_sold) AS total_sales FROM promotions p JOIN sales_filtered sf ON p.promo_id = sf.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_category), total_sales AS (SELECT SUM(total_sales) AS grand_total FROM agg_sales) SELECT a.promo_category, a.total_sales, (a.total_sales / t.grand_total) * 100 AS sales_percentage FROM agg_sales a, total_sales t ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL将占比结果乘以100输出为百分比数值，而Gold SQL输出的是小数，且排序依据不同（Pred按总销售额降序，Gold按占比降序），但排序结果一致。

question: 我想看商品活跃留存：有多少个 SKU 在2018年的一季度和四季度都持续有销售记录？

Effective diff desc: 过滤条件不同：Gold SQL使用STR_TO_DATE将mth转换为日期后比较，范围包括2018-01-01至2018-04-01之前和2018-10-01至2019-01-01之前，即完整的第一季度和第四季度；Pred SQL使用字符串BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-03'及BETWEEN '2018-10' AND '2018-12'，字符串比较时月末日期（如2018-03-31、2018-12-31）可能不被包含，导致结果差异。

pred-sql: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DATE(day) AS d, SUM(counter) AS cnt FROM web_counter_hist WHERE day BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-06-30' GROUP BY d ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC LIMIT 3;
Effective diff desc: 数据源表不同：gold_sql使用`WEB_PAGE_VISITS`表并通过STR_TO_DATE解析visit_time，pred_sql使用`web_counter_hist`表并直接聚合counter字段，且日期范围边界条件不同（pred_sql使用BETWEEN包含6月30日，gold_sql使用< '2019-07-01'）

question: 我想看哪些应用挂了最多页面编号，先把页面规模最大的 app 给我前 10 个。
Gold-sql: SELECT p.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.page_no) AS external_cnt FROM ORACLE_SQL.WEB_PAGES p GROUP BY p.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.page_no) > 1 ORDER BY external_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
pred-sql: SELECT w.name, COUNT(wp.page_no) AS page_count FROM web_apps w JOIN web_pages wp ON w.id = wp.app_id GROUP BY w.id, w.name ORDER BY page_count DESC LIMIT 10
Effective diff desc: 使用的表不同（Gold仅使用WEB_PAGES表，Pred使用了web_apps和web_pages并做JOIN）；SELECT列不同（Gold选app_id，Pred选name）；聚合函数不同（Gold使用COUNT(DISTINCT page_no)去重计数，Pred使用COUNT(page_no)总计数）；分组不同（Gold按app_id分组，Pred按id和name分组）；过滤条件不同（Gold有HAVING过滤多于1个不同page_no，Pred无HAVING条件）；这些差异导致结果不一致。

pred-sql: SELECT DATE(last_activity_date) AS activity_date, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS active_post_cnt FROM stackoverflow_posts WHERE last_activity_date >= '2001-01-01' AND last_activity_date < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY DATE(last_activity_date) ORDER BY activity_date ASC
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL 直接对 last_activity_date 列使用 DATE 函数，未进行 Gold SQL 中的微秒到秒的除以 1000000 和 FROM_UNIXTIME 转换，导致日期维度计算错误；聚合方式用 COUNT(DISTINCT id) 而非 COUNT(*)，计数指标不同；过滤条件中时间范围的列值类型和表达方式也不同，整体执行结果与 Gold SQL 不一致。

pred-sql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(year_of_crash, '-', month_of_crash, '-', day_of_crash), '%Y-%c-%e') AS crash_date, COUNT(*) AS accident_cnt FROM nhtsa_traffic_fatalities_accident_2016 WHERE year_of_crash = 2016 GROUP BY crash_date ORDER BY crash_date ASC
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL与Gold SQL执行结果不一致：Pred SQL使用year_of_crash、month_of_crash、day_of_crash三个字段拼接构造日期作为分组字段，而Gold SQL使用timestamp_of_crash时间戳转换后的日期作为分组字段。如果同一记录中timestamp_of_crash对应的实际日期与这三个字段组合出的日期不一致，会导致分组结果不同。此外，过滤条件差异明显：Pred SQL仅按year_of_crash = 2016过滤，而Gold SQL通过FROM_UNIXTIME对时间戳严格限定在2016-01-01 00:00:00至2016-12-31 23:59:59之间。若存在year_of_crash=2016但时间戳落在该范围之外的记录，Pred SQL会包含但Gold SQL会排除，反之亦然，直接影响计数。
